title: StrictLocalInjectiveSourceComparison
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point,
$K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{et}))$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, $J$ be a fixed bounded-below complex
of injectives and $q:K\cong QJ$. For each pointed affine neighbourhood $i$, define a
specific isomorphism $A_i:F_i\cong B_{t_i}$, where $F_i$ is the derived sections Hom
of $Rf_*K$ [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs], and $B_{t_i}$ is the
actual termwise sections cohomology [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison].
Use the right-derived unit on $J$ and $q$ to identify $Rf_*K$ with $Q(f_*J)$
[def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Use full faithfulness of the bounded-below inclusion,
the single and shift comparisons, and localization on Hom into the K-injective
complex $f_*J$ to identify $F_i$ with $H^n\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(\mathbf Z[V_i],f_*J)$.
Evaluate the free generator degreewise using the sheafification/free-abelian/Yoneda
adjunctions. Identify $(f_*J)(V_i)$ with sections of $t_i^{-1}J$ using the canonical
localization-restriction isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction],
and take homology using the localization-homology comparison. This composition
constructs $A_i$, without choosing any existence witness. No transition, cone-leg,
continuity or mate-invertibility assertion is part of this definition.

lean.statement: def strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})) (n : ℤ) (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))) (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) (i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) : (strictLocalCohomologyNeighbourhoodFunctor s ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) n).obj (op i) ≅ termwiseSectionsCohomology ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj i) (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) n
